displayName: SIG — SIG-ALERT log line on sig-alerts

documentation.content: sig-alerts emitted a SIG-ALERT line — a probe-hosted sweep reported a critical target down (or another SIG-ALERT emitter fired). Check: gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="sig-alerts" AND textPayload:"SIG-ALERT"' --project {project} --freshness=24h. Created by P34.4 (QA-4); the sig-alerts receiver is the SIG-ALERT webhook target (ops/src/ops/alerts.py).
